fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 14ft aluminum Crestliner boat (hull only, no trailer), which we can clean and polish.
findings: Flaking, peeling red paint across the hull sides and transom corners
Green mildew/algae film on the upturned hull bottom near the bow
Dark grime and staining inside the hull along the ribs and floor
Dirt and debris buildup in the stern compartments
Dull, oxidized bare aluminum on the gunwales and bow handle area
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 14ft Crestliner. The photos show some green film on the hull bottom and dark grime inside along the ribs and floor. We do mobile pre-sale cleanups and aluminum polishing and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
